# Enqueue Element

![Enqueue Element function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/synchronization/queue/02_Enqueue%20element.svg)

[Synchronization functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Adds one element at the tail. A full bounded FIFO waits cooperatively for space: timeout -1 waits indefinitely, 0 attempts immediately. Expiration inserts nothing. It never silently evicts an element; invalidation interrupts the wait with an error. Queue&lt;T&gt; is an execution resource reference; element is the ordinary T value. Public FROG target compilation remains unavailable.

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

Adds one element at the tail. A full bounded FIFO waits cooperatively for space: timeout -1 waits indefinitely, 0 attempts immediately. Expiration inserts nothing. It never silently evicts an element; invalidation interrupts the wait with an error.

## Queue behavior

Writes exactly one complete T message at the tail. A full bounded queue waits for space; an ordinary timeout inserts nothing. It never evicts an older message. Check timed out? and error out before treating the write as successful.

Queue&lt;T&gt; is a nominal execution-resource access reference. The complete T schema is invariant; an Array, Cluster or Enum message remains one T value. Collection outputs add one outer rank-1 Array.

Timeout is I32 milliseconds: -1 waits without a deadline, 0 attempts immediately, and nonnegative values bound the wait. Waiting is cooperative. Invalidation wakes waits with an error.
